hero.h1: Bathroom Remodeling in Grand Rapids With the Owner on Site
hero.subheadline: JBJ Building & Remodeling is a family-owned West Michigan builder founded in 2002. Owner Jamie Simmons meets every customer, and his crew is known for level, exact tile work.

image.alt: Bathroom remodeling Grand Rapids area: master bath with dark double vanity, marble countertop, gold faucets and black-framed mirrors

intro.h2: Tile-first remodels from a Comstock Park crew
paragraphs: JBJ Building & Remodeling has handled bathroom remodeling in Grand Rapids and the towns around it for more than 20 years. The office is on 6 Mile Court in Comstock Park, and the work runs from attic baths and master suites to kitchens, basements, additions and decks.

Tile is where this crew stands out. They set complex patterns, large-format tile and in-floor heating, with careful subfloor prep so grout lines stay true for decades. One Google reviewer came to Jamie on a referral from The Tile Shop for a fireplace wall in 16 by 24 inch natural slate. Another said the level of the tile impressed him most.

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: From growing a cramped master bath into a full suite to refreshing a small guest bath, JBJ handles the plumbing, electrical and finish work. Popular features include curbless walk-in showers with built-in niches, freestanding soaking tubs and custom double vanities.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with a blue and white patterned tile shower under a sloped ceiling, gold fixtures, wood vanity and dark floor tile

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Jamie looks at your kitchen's current footprint to work out the best flow. The crew installs custom cabinetry, granite or quartz counters, lighting and fixtures, and handles everything from the first teardown to the final coat of paint, in modern or traditional styles.

image.alt: White kitchen remodel with a black and brass gas range, curved white hood, marble counters and a brass faucet over a farmhouse sink

items.name: Custom Tile
items.blurb: Kitchen backsplashes, waterproof tile shower enclosures, mudroom and entry floors, and heated tile floors. The crew specializes in complex patterns and large-format tile, with proper subfloor prep, precise cuts and straight grout lines so the finish does not crack or shift.

image.alt: Vintage-style bathroom with white subway tile walls, mint green upper walls, black and white penny tile floor and a pedestal sink

items.name: Additions and New Builds
items.blurb: Extra bedrooms, mother-in-law apartments, home offices, room additions and custom homes built from the ground up. JBJ pulls the permits, coordinates trades, deliveries and inspections, and matches the new space to your house. Jamie oversees the structural work himself.

image.alt: Home addition under construction in West Michigan with new roof framing and white weather barrier

items.name: Custom Decks
items.blurb: Multi-level decks in premium wood or composite with modern railing systems. Recent builds include a two-story deck with black metal railings and stairs on a brick home, and a wood deck built right up to an above-ground pool.

image.alt: Wood deck with steps and metal railing built beside an above-ground pool at a West Michigan home

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners choose JBJ for bathroom remodeling in Grand Rapids

items.title: The owner stays involved
items.text: Jamie Simmons meets with every customer and stays involved in every project. On additions and new builds he oversees the structural work himself, so you are never handed off to a stranger.

items.title: Detail you can see in the tile
items.text: One Google reviewer said the level of the tile and a built-in linen cabinet, nailed, puttied and sanded, were 'so perfect.' Another was sent to Jamie by The Tile Shop.

items.title: No corners cut
items.text: A master bath client wrote that Jamie refused to cut corners and built the room exactly as designed, even when that took a little longer. His ideas kept the budget in check and matched the house.

items.title: Permits and product warranties covered
items.text: JBJ is licensed and insured, pulls every needed permit and builds to code. The company also stands by the manufacturer's warranty on all the products it supplies.

about.text: Jamie Simmons leads JBJ Building & Remodeling Inc., a family-owned company rooted in Western Michigan since 2002. He built it on a simple idea: a home should reflect the people who live in it, so each project is tailored from quote to completion. Jamie meets with all customers himself, and reviewers often name him for ideas that stay within budget and suit the style of the house. Clients name his crew too, like Don, praised for a bath and a built-in linen cabinet, and Kevin, who set a natural slate fireplace wall.

image.alt: Jamie Simmons, owner of JBJ Building & Remodeling in Comstock Park, MI

process.h2: From first call to final coat of paint

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: Call or send the form with your project type, address and estimated budget. The team aims to respond promptly to every inquiry.

steps.title: Walkthrough with Jamie
steps.text: Jamie meets you at the house, looks at the current layout and talks through ideas that fit your budget and the style of your home.

steps.title: Permits and scheduling
steps.text: JBJ pulls the permits and lines up the trades, deliveries and inspections so the job keeps moving once work begins.

steps.title: Build and finish
steps.text: The crew handles demolition, plumbing, electrical, tile and trim through to the final coat of paint, with Jamie involved the whole way.

service_area.h2: Serving Comstock Park, Ada, Rockford and greater Grand Rapids
service_area.text: JBJ works from its Comstock Park office across the north and east sides of Grand Rapids and into the southwest suburbs. The company has served Ada, Rockford and East Grand Rapids for more than 20 years, and its own list adds Cascade, Belmont, Cannonsburg, Grandville, Byron Center and the lower east corner of Sparta. If your town is close to these, call and ask.

items.a: Yes. JBJ offers a free consultation and free quote. Call 616-862-8778 or fill out the contact form with your name, project type, project address and estimated budget. The team aims to respond promptly, and Jamie meets with every customer before any work is planned or priced.

Yes. JBJ Building & Remodeling Inc. is fully licensed and insured. The company handles all aspects of permitting for your project, pulls every permit the job needs and builds strictly to code. It also stands by the manufacturer's warranty on all products it supplies.

items.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the room and the scope, and Jamie sets the plan at your walkthrough. For reference, one Google reviewer's complete attic bathroom took 8 weeks against a 6-week plan, and the owner still called the result fantastic. Jamie would rather take a little longer than cut corners.

items.q: Can you install heated tile floors?
items.a: Yes. In-floor heating is part of the custom tile service, along with complex patterns, large-format tile, waterproof shower enclosures and backsplashes. The crew starts with proper subfloor preparation, then makes precise cuts and keeps grout lines straight so the floor holds up for decades without cracking or shifting.

items.q: Will you finish a project another contractor left?
items.a: JBJ has done it. A Google reviewer hired Jamie and his crew after a previous contractor walked away midway through their kitchen remodel. She wrote that they were responsive and professional, did great work, and that she only wished she had called them first. Call to talk through where your project stands.

final_cta.text: Call 616-862-8778, or send the form with your project and budget and the team will get back to you promptly.

current_site_defects: Measured: Google PageSpeed mobile performance score 57.
Measured: horizontal overflow at 375px; the page is 389px wide because the Google review slider (ti-review-item) runs 14px past the right edge, so the page scrolls sideways on phones.
The home page has no H1; its first heading is an H2 'JBJ BUILDING & REMODELING INC.', and both phone numbers are marked up as H2s on every page.
Two phone numbers (616-862-8778 and office 616-648-0141) and two emails (including a sbcglobal.net address) compete in the header; only 616-862-8778 matches Google.
The Custom Decks service page returned a Cloudflare 504 gateway time-out when crawled.
No hours anywhere on the site, and no process explained before the contact form, which requires an estimated budget.
The kitchen page leads with what looks like a stock photo of a designer holding a paint fan deck instead of their own kitchens.
Research notes say the July 2026 Elementor rebuild still carries placeholder lorem-ipsum blog posts.
The service area list sits only on the About and Contact pages; the home page names just Ada, Rockford and East Grand Rapids.
what_this_homepage_fixes: One clear H1 on 'bathroom remodeling Grand Rapids', with 4.9 stars from 32 Google reviews and 'since 2002' in the hero.
One phone number, 616-862-8778, matching Google, as tap-to-call at the top and bottom; the free consultation is the second button.
Leads with the tile craftsmanship that reviewers single out, using their own bath and kitchen photos with descriptive alt text.
Adds a short four-step process and FAQ so the budget field on the form feels less abrupt.
Lists every town from the About page in a service area section and in schema.
Reviews are quoted as plain text, so no slider pushes the page wider than a phone screen.
conversion_notes.best_conversion_angle: Owner-led tile and bath specialists: Jamie meets every customer, refuses to cut corners, and his crew's tile work gets called 'so perfect' by Google reviewers, family-owned since 2002.
conversion_notes.outreach_hook: On an iPhone your home page scrolls sideways because the Google review slider is 14px too wide, and it has no H1 at all; here is a version that fixes both and leads with your tile work.
